# Oxford Realty Advisors

> Private, family-owned industrial real estate investment firm. Acquires Class B/C shallow-bay industrial, flex, and IOS properties ($1M-$10M, under 50,000 SF) across the Mid-Atlantic and Midwest with 100% family capital and all-cash closings in 30-45 days. Owns and operates 513,000+ SF with 138+ tenants — core markets Maryland and Columbus (OH), plus a Kansas City (MO) holding.

Oxford Realty Advisors (founded 2005) is a principal investor and operator — not a fund — targeting the structural undersupply of functional Class B/C industrial space in secondary markets. Properties are acquired below replacement cost and held for the long term with no outside investors, no capital calls, and no investment committee. Core markets are Maryland (Columbia, Owings Mills, Eastern Shore, Baltimore) and Columbus, OH; Kansas City, MO is a holding.

## Notes

- Oxford acquires with 100% proprietary capital — no financing contingency, no appraisal contingency, no minimum occupancy requirement.
- Brokers who upload an offering memorandum on the For Brokers page see an automated Preliminary Buy-Box Score shortly after upload. It is an estimate, not a commitment or offer; the team then reviews the deal directly and responds within one business day.
- Oxford Realty Advisors (Potomac, MD) is not affiliated with any other similarly named real estate firm or brokerage.
